title: Deep Breathing Can Reduce Stress, Anxiety
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: From VOA Learning English, this is the Health & Lifestyle report.
sentences.zh: 从VOA学习英语, 这是健康和生活方式报告。

sentences.en: At Myosin Marketing in Austin, Texas, the group employee meeting begins with an uncommon activity for a workplace.
sentences.zh: 在德克萨斯州奥斯汀的 Myosin Marketing, 集体雇员会议开始于一个工作场所的不寻常活动。

sentences.en: The members gather on Zoom and the head of the company, Sean Clayton, leads them through a deep-breathing exercise.
sentences.zh: 成员聚集在苏姆和公司负责人肖恩·克莱顿,领导他们进行深呼吸演习。

sentences.en: Clayton says the activity helps his employees relax and to be willing to take creative risks.
sentences.zh: Clayton说这个活动能帮助他的员工放松 并愿意承担创造性的风险

sentences.en: “At first they thought it was really weird ,” he said, adding that most people turned off their cameras.
sentences.zh: 他补充说, 大多数人都关掉了相机。

sentences.en: But, after a couple of weeks, there was a change.
sentences.zh: 但是,几个星期后,发生了一些变化。

sentences.en: The employees said the deep breathing felt good.
sentences.zh: 员工们说深呼吸感觉很好

sentences.en: Studies show that deep breathing can be an effective way to reduce tension, or stress, at work.
sentences.zh: 研究表明,深呼吸可以成为减少工作紧张或压力的有效途径。

sentences.en: But people may not think about their breathing while on the job.
sentences.zh: 但人们在工作时可能不会想到呼吸。

sentences.en: Workers who sit at computers for long periods tend to take shallow breaths as their shoulders slowly rise.
sentences.zh: 长时间坐在电脑上工作的工人往往在肩膀缓慢上升时呼吸浅薄。

sentences.en: Workers who spend the day on their feet in retail or health care may be too busy to center their attention on breathing.
sentences.zh: 在零售业或医疗保健业度过一天的工人可能太忙,无法将注意力集中在呼吸上。

sentences.en: But there is good reason to stop what you are doing and take deep breaths, research suggests.
sentences.zh: 但有很好的理由 停止你在做什么 并深呼吸, 研究表明。

sentences.en: Long-lasting stress can increase the risk of heart disease and stroke.
sentences.zh: 长期压力可增加心脏病和中风的风险。

sentences.en: Experts at the American Heart Association say it can be as harmful as secondhand smoke.
sentences.zh: 美国心脏协会的专家说,它可能像二手烟一样有害。

sentences.en: Research suggests deep-breathing exercises can lower a person’s blood pressure and reduce anxiety .
sentences.zh: 研究显示,深呼吸练习可以降低一个人的血压,减少焦虑。

sentences.en: There are many benefits to deep breathing.
sentences.zh: 深呼吸有许多好处。

sentences.en: For starters, it is free. It can be done anywhere.
sentences.zh: 首先,它是免费的,可以在任何地方完成。

sentences.en: And unlike a 30-minute meditation practice, most deep breathing exercises do not take much time.
sentences.zh: 与30分钟的冥想练习不同,大多数深呼吸练习不需要多少时间。

sentences.en: Also, it gives you something to focus on – your breathing.
sentences.zh: 而且,这给了你一些东西 专注于你的呼吸。

sentences.en: Experts say that this can help to calm racing thoughts.
sentences.zh: 专家说,这可以帮助平息赛事思维。

sentences.en: Focusing on breathing for one to five minutes can help you clear your mind and let you “get back to focusing on the one thing you want to accomplish ,” said Glenn Levine.
sentences.zh: 格伦·莱文说,专心呼吸一至五分钟可以帮助你清醒头脑,并让你“重新专注于你想要完成的一件事”。

sentences.en: He is a heart and blood system doctor and professor at Baylor College of Medicine in Houston, Texas.
sentences.zh: 他是德克萨斯州休斯顿Baylor医学院的心脏和血液系统医生和教授。

sentences.en: A good way to do deep breathing exercises is outside, Levine said.
sentences.zh: 莱文说,外面是进行深呼吸的好办法。

sentences.en: However, if that is not possible, doing them at a desk works.
sentences.zh: 但是,如果做不到这一点,则在办公桌旁工作。

sentences.en: “Instead of focusing on the screen or work, just focus on your breathing.
sentences.zh: “重点不是放在屏幕或工作上,而是放在你的呼吸上。

sentences.en: If possible,” Levine said, “close your eyes.” Even very busy people can find time for daily breathing exercises.
sentences.zh: 如果可能的话,莱文说 : “ 闭上你的眼睛。 ”即使非常忙碌的人也能找到时间每天做呼吸锻炼。

sentences.en: Lisa Marie Deleveaux is a marketing professional and mother of five.
sentences.zh: Lisa Marie Deleveaux是营销专业人士,有五位母亲。

sentences.en: She lost her job several months ago and has struggled to find a new one.
sentences.zh: 她几个月前丢了工作 拼命找新工作

sentences.en: Deleveaux wakes early most mornings before her children, to do breathing exercises.
sentences.zh: 德莱沃在孩子出生前早早醒来 做呼吸锻炼

sentences.en: “If you set a priority for yourself ... you can make the time,” Deleveaux said.
sentences.zh: 德莱沃说,“如果你为自己确定一个优先事项......你可以抽出时间。”

sentences.en: With one breathing exercise, she breaths in through one nostril and then out through the other.
sentences.zh: 通过一次呼吸运动,她呼吸 通过一个鼻孔,然后通过另一个。

sentences.en: She uses a thumb or forefinger to hold one nostril closed at a time.
sentences.zh: 她用拇指或指头 一次闭合一个鼻孔

sentences.en: “It relaxes my mind. It makes my mind so full of ease.
sentences.zh: “它使我放松,使我的思维变得非常轻松。

sentences.en: It brings you back to the present moment,” she added.
sentences.zh: 她补充说,这让你回到现在。

sentences.en: To get ahead of anxiety before starting her workday, sales representative Lindsay Carlisle of Michigan does breathing exercises with her seven-year-old daughter during their drive to school.
sentences.zh: 为了在上班前先发制人 密歇根州的销售代表Lindsay Carlisle 在她七岁的女儿去上学的路上 和她一起做呼吸锻炼

sentences.en: They breathe in for seven counts, hold their breath for five, and then breathe out for seven counts.
sentences.zh: 他们呼吸了7次 屏住呼吸5次 然后呼吸了7次

sentences.en: They repeat this several times. “Throughout that process, my shoulders start to drop on their own, and it really is calming,” Carlisle said.
sentences.zh: 他们重复了好几次。 Carlisle说, “ 在整个过程中,我的肩膀开始落在他们身上,这确实令人平静。 ”

sentences.en: Suze Yalof Schwartz was an overworked magazine editor when her mother-in-law taught her a three-minute meditation method.
sentences.zh: Suze Yalof Schwartz是一份工作过量的杂志编辑,当时她岳母教她一个三分钟的冥想方法。

sentences.en: Yalof Schwartz says it changed her life.
sentences.zh: 雅洛夫·施瓦兹说这改变了她的生活

sentences.en: She left her career and founded Unplug Meditation, a Santa Monica, California, company with a meditation studio, an app, and programs for corporate customers.
sentences.zh: 她离开了事业 创建了"Unplet Medication" 加州圣莫尼卡公司 拥有一个冥想工作室 一个应用程序 还有公司客户的程序

sentences.en: “When we slow down our breath, we send a signal to our brain that everything’s OK, even when it’s not,” she said.
sentences.zh: 她说:「当我们放慢呼吸时, 我们向大脑发出一个信号,

sentences.en: Another 16-second breathing exercise is called box breathing.
sentences.zh: 另一个16秒的呼吸锻炼叫做箱式呼吸。

sentences.en: You breathe in for four counts, hold for four, breathe out for four counts and hold for another four.
sentences.zh: 呼吸4次 呼吸4次 呼吸4次 呼吸4次 再呼吸4次

sentences.en: Yalof Schwartz has taught it to people in stressful jobs including firefighters, police and doctors.
sentences.zh: Yalof Schwartz向从事紧张工作的人,包括消防员、警察和医生教授了这一课程。

sentences.en: “It is the best thing that you can do at work before you have a meeting, before you send out an email that you wish you didn’t send, before you have a difficult conversation, because it just calms you down, gets rid of your negative energy,” she said.
sentences.zh: 她说:「这是你开会前工作上最好的事情, 在你发出希望你没有发送的电子邮件之前,

sentences.en: Employers such as Coca-Cola, Mattel and Netflix have used Unplug Meditation to teach breathing or meditation.
sentences.zh: Coca-Cola、Mattel和Netflix等雇主使用Unplet Medication教授呼吸或冥想。

sentences.en: It is not always easy for workers to find space for deep breathing exercises.
sentences.zh: 工人并不总是容易找到深吸气练习的空间。

sentences.en: For example, salespeople often work alongside their customers.
sentences.zh: 例如,销售人员经常与其客户一起工作。

sentences.en: Yalof Schwartz suggests doing breathing exercises when making a sale or organizing items.
sentences.zh: Yalof Schwartz建议在销售或组织物品时进行呼吸锻炼。

sentences.en: Carlisle, the sales representative, sets a timer on her phone telling her to breathe deeply.
sentences.zh: 销售代表Carlisle在电话上设定了定时器 让她深呼吸

sentences.en: She also keeps a note near her computer that simply says “Breathe.” “The anxiety is always going to be there,” Carlisle said. “But at least I know I have one small tool. ...
sentences.zh: 卡莱尔说,“但至少我知道我有一个小工具。 ”她还在电脑上贴上一张纸条,上面写着“呼吸 ” 。 ”卡莱尔说, “ 焦虑总会存在。 ”

sentences.en: It sounds so simple and silly , but it works.” And that’s the Health & Lifestyle report.
sentences.zh: 这听起来既简单又愚蠢,但很管用。 这是《健康与生活方式报告》。

sentences.en: I’m Anna Matteo. And I’m Mario Ritter, Jr.
sentences.zh: 我是Anna Matteo, 我是小Mario Ritter。

sentences.en: Cathy Bussewitz reported this story for the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: 凯西·布塞维兹为美联社报道了这个故事

sentences.zh: Anna Matteo改编成VOA英文学习版。
